notes: Claim evidence fields are summarised; claims are numbered in document order (summary c01, keyPoints c02-c06, body c07-c42). Anaphylaxis figures conflict (NHS England fewer than 1 in 100,000; NHS Wales about 1 in a million), so the figure was dropped. Chickenpox catch-up (1 Nov 2026 to 31 Mar 2028, births 1 Jan 2020 to 31 Aug 2022) came from one search summary of GOV.UK MMRV pages; the 6-in-1 cut-off date (NHS 1 July 2024 vs GOV.UK guide title 1 Jan 2025) conflicts. Fever thresholds omitted (cut-offs). Flu details reflect the 2026/27 NHS page.
